title: UnityBench-Mini3D: Evaluating LLM Agents for 3D Game Development in Unity
abstract: arXiv:2610.35980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Game development stresses coding agents in ways general software engineering does not: correctness depends on how engine APIs, serialized scene state, and runtime behavior interact, not on source code alone. Existing benchmarks mainly target platforms such as Godot and heavily rely on LLM judges or coarse task-level outcomes. We present UnityBench-Mini3D, a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks organized around seven expert-defined skill categories rather than tutorials or genres, with three difficulty tiers. Each task pairs a complete Unity project with natural-language requirements and is evaluated using 1,178 held-out, human-authored milestone tests covering scene structure, component configuration, and runtime behavior. This in-engine evaluation provides deterministic partial credit, localizes failures, and distinguishes partial implementations from complete solutions without relying on subjective judges. translated_title: UnityBench-Mini3D：评估Unity中3D游戏开发的LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 游戏开发对代码智能体的考验方式与一般软件工程不同：正确性取决于引擎API、序列化场景状态和运行时行为之间的交互，而不仅仅是源代码本身。现有基准主要针对Godot等平台，并且严重依赖LLM评判器或粗粒度的任务级结果。我们提出了UnityBench-Mini3D，这是一个包含77个项目级Unity任务的基准，围绕七个由专家定义的技能类别（而非教程或游戏类型）组织，并设有三个难度等级。每个任务将一个完整的Unity项目与自然语言需求相配对，并使用1,178个留出的、由人工编写的里程碑测试进行评估，这些测试涵盖场景结构、组件配置和运行时行为。这种引擎内评估提供了确定性的部分得分，可以定位失败点，并区分部分实现与完整解决方案，而无需依赖主观评判器。在21个模型和9个（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: UnityBench-Mini3D是一个包含77个Unity项目级任务的基准，通过1,178个人工编写的引擎内里程碑测试对LLM智能体的3D游戏开发能力进行确定性评估，可提供部分得分、定位失败点，无需依赖主观的LLM评判器。
en_tdlr: UnityBench-Mini3D is a benchmark of 77 project-level Unity tasks evaluated by 1,178 human-authored in-engine milestone tests, providing deterministic partial credit and failure localization for LLM agents' 3D game development capabilities without relying on subjective LLM judges.
